description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated nursing leader to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence. You will be instrumental in fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This role offers a competitive annual salary and the chance to lead a compassionate and skilled nursing team, driving continuous improvement in patient outcomes and overall facility performance.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Proven ability to manage, mentor, and develop nursing staff
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.
